purpose: Native ordinary-flight source rectangles for all 48 bullet types and every configured color; spawning/disappearance effects excluded.

native_lookup.sprite_callback_evidence: Read-only existing Ghidra listing 0x429a20..0x429a58: negative first ordinary sprite passes literal ANM sprite id through; otherwise reads table+4+type*0x118+source_color*0x10+anm_sprite_index*4. Existing DB unchanged before/after.
native_lookup.fixed_color_input: The sprite callback ignores source_color whenever the type first ordinary sprite is negative; source_color=null represents that fixed art, not a missing mapping.
native_lookup.evidence_confidence: Verified statically: native instruction lookup + actual EXE table + ANM ordinary state + PNG bounds; no original runtime observation.
native_lookup.ordinary_state: ANM interruptLabel(2); normal blocks either select sprite0/literal animation, or retain initial sprite0. Initial sprite1 is spawn-only.
native_lookup.orientation: BulletManager__on_draw 0x424eb0 sets rotationZ = bullet heading + pi/2 when rotateAuto is enabled. Thus unrotated directional source art points upward; raw rectangles preserve original art orientation.
